inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.constructor.http
inputs.description: The hosted HTTP adapter used by the service's read and discovery helpers to request hosted JSON. It matters when a snapshot or remote resource is loaded.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.constructor.options
inputs.description: Options passed to HostedReadService and used by this service. The cache option controls whether read fetches snapshot metadata before loading a resource.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.branch.projectId
inputs.description: The hosted project identifier whose last recorded branch is requested. It must satisfy the hosted project ID format checked when building API paths.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.snapshot.input
inputs.type: { projectId: string; branch: string | null; commit: string | null; }
inputs.description: Selects the hosted project and optional branch and commit query values for the snapshot request. A non-null commit is also checked against the validated snapshot revision.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.read.input
inputs.type: { projectId: string; commit: string; branch?: string | null }
inputs.description: Selects the hosted project and required expected commit for a resource read, with an optional branch query value. When caching is enabled, the commit is checked against freshly fetched snapshot metadata.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.read.operation
inputs.description: The operation path segment used to form the hosted resource URL. The snapshot segment is used by this implementation when it fetches snapshot metadata.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.read.validate
inputs.description: A caller-supplied function that validates an unknown fetched or cached value and returns the caller's type T. It is applied before a value is returned.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.read.load
inputs.description: An optional asynchronous provider for the raw resource value. If omitted, the service fetches the computed resource path through the HTTP adapter.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.path.projectId
inputs.description: The hosted project identifier inserted into the API path after validation and URL encoding. Identifiers must match the service's alphanumeric, dot, underscore, and hyphen format.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.path.operation
inputs.description: The operation path segment appended after the hosted project identifier. An empty string omits that segment.

inputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.path.input
inputs.description: An object whose enumerable non-null values become URL query parameters, except projectId. Null and undefined values are omitted.

outputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.branch
outputs.description: The branch recorded by the most recent successful snapshot for this project. It is null until the service has recorded a branch.

outputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.snapshot
outputs.description: The validated project snapshot after the hosted read result is applied. Offline results become non-writable, and any cache metadata is marked offline and read-only when present.

outputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.projects
outputs.description: The project-discovery result for the principal's owned and joined projects. The discovery helper reads a newly found project once so it can be kept offline.

outputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.read
outputs.description: The value returned by the caller's validator for the fetched or cached resource. Its shape is defined by generic T and the validator; with caching enabled, matching snapshot metadata for the requested commit is required.

outputs.name: RemoteProjectionService.path
outputs.description: A relative hosted API URL containing the encoded project identifier, optional operation segment, and eligible query parameters. It throws when the project identifier fails the hosted ID format check.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when projectionPath receives a project ID that does not match the hosted project identifier pattern.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when a validated snapshot has cache.identity.sourceCommit different from revision.commit.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when a non-empty requested commit differs from the validated snapshot revision.commit.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Thrown when fetched snapshot metadata has a revision.commit different from the requested commit.
